m_p1:
Furniture, just like our sheets or our clothes, gets a little dirty every time we use it, but unlike our clothes we tend to think it isn't important to clean our furniture so often. That's the mistake!

Few places in your home are used more than your sofa. It's a seat, a drink holder, a place to recover when you're sick, and a comfort for guests looking to secretly wipe their hands.
m_p2:
Cleaning furniture not only makes it look nicer and smell better; it significantly improves the room's air quality, reduces allergies, and the risk of asthma.

Furniture cleaning focuses mainly on completely removing dust mites, skin residue, and any particles hidden in the surface.

As a cleaning company specialized in furniture and upholstery cleaning, we offer a deep furniture cleaning service where we guarantee removing 100% of bad odors, mites, and dirt.
m_p3:
There's a certain satisfaction in welcoming your guests into a clean room, and at the same time there are few things more unpleasant than sitting on a sofa that smells bad, feels damp, or sticky. How many times have you flipped a sofa cushion or a pillow to hide stains or visible wear?

A deep furniture cleaning lets you show off your style without embarrassment. When your furniture looks clean, the whole room makes a good impression. If you think a professional cleaning is needed to bring that splendor back to your furniture, we as a cleaning company can help you.
m_p4:
All our furniture, mattress, and carpet cleaning processes include a chemical disinfection to remove any dirt or agent not visible to the naked eye.

A machine brushing to remove stains of dirt, food, and dust accumulated in the furniture.

And finally, a vacuuming to extract all the mites and liquids the furniture may hold.
m_rec: Remember, if you want a deep cleaning you can't do it dry — especially if you want to remove any mischief from the household's furry ones.
c_p1:
Not only is a quiet, dimly lit environment important for restful sleep — the hygiene of our sheets, and especially our mattress, is key to proper rest, and the best proof of this is how well we sleep right after changing the sheets. But unlike our sheets, we almost never spend time cleaning the mattress, and it really needs it.

There is no single object in our home that we use more than our mattress — on average 6 to 8 hours a day — and precisely because of all this use we leave our sweat and skin fragments on it, creating the perfect environment for the dust mites that cause allergies and skin diseases.
c_p2:
By cleaning our mattress we get the same effect as washing our sheets, but on a large scale; we can even feel the bed fresher after a deep mattress cleaning that removes all the sweat, body oils, or even the occasional blood stain.

If you start to notice that you are not resting well, the most likely cause is the lack of a deep mattress cleaning. Remember, a good mattress cleaning should be done every 6 months, and a simple vacuuming every month.
c_p3:
A deep mattress cleaning not only removes mites and makes the room smell pleasant; it significantly improves the room's air quality, reduces allergies, and the risk of asthma.

It doesn't end with allergies: poor bed hygiene can become (and will become) a breeding ground for bacteria and fungi. Even if one person (in the case of a double bed) has athlete's foot, being highly contagious, there is a high chance the other will immediately suffer the condition, even while under treatment.

As a cleaning company specialized in mattress, furniture, and upholstery cleaning, we offer a deep mattress cleaning service where we guarantee removing 100% of bad odors, mites, and dirt.
c_p4:
All our furniture, mattress, and carpet cleaning processes include a chemical disinfection to remove any dirt or agent not visible to the naked eye.

A machine brushing to remove stains of dirt, food, and accumulated dust.

And finally, a vacuuming to extract all the mites and liquids that may remain.
c_rec: Remember, as specialists we know that dry cleaning is not the best option, especially if you want to remove a stain caused by the curiosity of the little ones at home.
a_p1:
Next time you want to rest, do it in a clean spot: we recommend the toilet seat. "It has the fewest bacteria of any place in your home," says Charles Gerba, Ph.D., professor of environmental microbiology at the University of Arizona.

In fact, there are 3,000 times more fecal coliforms — also known as fecal bacteria — in an average living-room carpet than in a typical toilet. Why? you may ask: the toilet is constantly being cleaned, while home carpets, at best, are vacuumed once a month.

In a recent study conducted in several countries of the Americas by the public education group Hygiene Council, a surprising 28 percent of homes were found to be heavily contaminated with bacteria, which can live on dry surfaces for days or even months.

In that time they can migrate — say, from the bathroom to your hand, from your shoes to the carpet. "It's something to keep in mind," says Philip Tierno Jr., Ph.D., microbiologist and immunologist at NYU Langone Medical Center and author of The Secret Life of Germs… "We love carpets, they are very comfortable and really pretty, but if you haven't done a deep carpet cleaning in the last 6 months, there is an ecosystem living there as diverse as the Amazon."
a_h2: Do you have pets? You have a bigger problem.
a_p2: And we haven't even started talking about the furry ones that make little messes everywhere; sometimes they leave a trail of odor on our carpets, and then it's obvious a professional carpet cleaning is needed. But in the vast majority of cases, even when it isn't obvious, they will leave their mark there — remember, they don't clean up after their mischief.
a_p3:
In addition to the above, a very serious problem caused by the lack of carpet cleaning is the pieces of dead skin, hair, and dust that accumulate in a carpet. This creates the perfect breeding ground for mites — tiny arachnids invisible to the human eye but present in every carpet — which can start causing quite serious health problems: allergies, asthma, and other respiratory illnesses. Dust and mites are the number 1 cause of irritation in people with allergies.

Vacuuming alone is not enough to eliminate all these problems from your carpet; you need a chemical disinfection (with no risk of damaging the fabric) to neutralize all these contaminants.

As a cleaning company specialized in carpet, mattress, and furniture cleaning, we offer a deep carpet cleaning service where we guarantee removing 100% of bad odors, mites, and dirt.

A machine brushing to remove stains of dirt, food, and dust accumulated in the carpets.

And finally, a vacuuming to extract all the mites and liquids the carpet may hold.
